items.title: (c) String Plucked at an Arbitrary Point (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: (c) String Plucked at an Arbitrary Point: a main subheading of 7.5 Stationary waves on a stretched string, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 147-147.

blocks.text: Maan lein string n loops mein resonate karti hai (zor se vibrate karti hai), jin mein (n + 1) nodes aur n antinodes hain. To n loops mein vibrate karti string par banne wali stationary waves ki frequency yeh hogi:
Aur us ki wavelength yeh hogi:

Saaf hai ke jitne zyada loops mein string vibrate kare, us ki frequency f utni barhti jati hai aur wavelength λ utni chhoti hoti jati hai. Lekin frequency f aur wavelength λ ka product (zarb) hamesha v, yaani waves ki speed, ke barabar rehta hai.
Upar ki baat se yeh results (nataij) nikalte hain:

items: Stationary waves ki frequencies ka ek alag alag (discrete) set hota hai: f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, …, nf₁; ise harmonic series kehte hain. Sab se kam frequency fundamental frequency f₁ hai, jo first harmonic hai. Frequency f₂ = 2f₁ second harmonic hai, waghaira.

Doosre lafzon mein resonance frequencies ke darmiyan frequency quantum jump (seedhi chhalang) se badalti hai; is ko Quantization of Frequencies kehte hain: fₙ = nf₁, jahan n = 1, 2, 3, … (poore numbers). String par stationary waves sirf harmonic series ki un frequencies par banti hain jo string ke tension, length aur mass per unit length se tay hoti hain. Jo waves harmonic series mein na hon woh jaldi damp ho jati hain (khatam ho jati hain).

Musical instrument ki string ki frequency tension badal kar ya length badal kar badli ja sakti hai. Misal: guitar aur violin ki strings ka tension instrument ki neck (gardan) par lagi pegs (khoontiyan) kas kar badla jata hai. Tune karne ke baad musician neck par ungliyan chala kar string ke vibrate karne wale hisse ki length badalte hain, aur is tarah frequency badalti hai.
